blocks.text: חו״ק
אֵל אֱמוּנָה בְּעָרְכְּךָ דִּין. אִם תְּמַצֶּה עֹֽמֶק הַדִּין. מִי יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ בַּדִּין. קָדוֹשׁ:
חו״ק
אִם לֹא לְמַעֲנוֹ יַֽעַשׂ. וְיָסִיר מֶנּוּ חֲרוֹן אַף וָכַֽעַשׂ. אֵין לְבַקֵּר וְלִמְצוֹא מַֽעַשׂ. קָדוֹשׁ:
כוונת הפייטן להזכיר כי מאדם הראשון עד יאשיהו איש לא עמד זכאי בדין, ומזה יבינו כל יצורי ארץ, אם בצדיקים דקדק הקב״ה כן ברשעים על אחת כמה וכמה. ושהמ״ח בראשי החרוזים אלעזר בירבי קליר.
ק׳

אֹמֶץ אַדִּירֵי כָּל חֵפֶץ. בְּהִתְבַּקְּרָם בַּדִּין חֻיְּבוּ לְנַפֵּץ. כְּלֹא נִמְצָא בָהֶם חֵפֶץ: אָדָם יְצִיר עָפָר מֵאֲדָמָה. לְאֵילֵי מָרוֹם אוֹתוֹ דִמָּה. לֹא בָן וְלַהֶבֶל דָּמָה: לַעֲבוֹד וְלִשְׁמוֹר גַּן הִפְרִישׁוֹ. וְעָבַר עַל צִוֻּיוֹ וַיְגָרְשׁוֹ. וְיוֹם זֶה לְיֹשֶׁר דְּרָשׁוֹ: לְעֵת הֵעִיר אֶזְרָח מִמַּאֲפֵל. עוֹלָם הָיָה תֹהוּ וּמְאֻפָּל. עֶשְׂרִים דּוֹר בָּזוּי וְשָׁפָל: עִקְּשִׁים בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר מַסְלוּל יִדַּע. וְעַל נָאֳמוֹ בַּמָּה אֵדַע. נִדּוֹן בְּכֵן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע: עוֹבְרִים בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא לְהִבָּדֵק. אִם כְּפָעֳלָם בְּרִיב יְדַקְדֵּק. לִפְנֵי שׁוֹפֵט מִי יִצְטַדֵּק: זָךְ הַמַּשְׁלִים בְּעֵקֶד נֶפֶשׁ. בְּזֹקֶן לֹא מָצָא נֹפֶשׁ. וַתִּכְהֶיןָ עֵינָיו בַּעֲשַׁן טִפֵּשׁ: זַרְעוֹ רִגֵּל בְּאָהֳלֵי תוֹרָה. וְעַל אָמְרוֹ דַרְכִּי נִסְתְּרָה. נִכְסָה מֶנּוּ פּוֹרָת בִּסְתִירָה: רָשָׁע אֲשֶׁר בְּמַחְבָּא יְחַתֵּר. צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וִינַתֵּר. אוּלַי בְּיוֹם אַף יִסָּתֵר: רֵעִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר כְּהִבְדִּיק. בְּרִיב אוֹתָם לֹא הִצְדִּיק. עַל מִכְרָם בַּכֶּסֶף צַדִּיק: בְּנֵי בְלִי שֵׁם בְּמָכְרָם עֲמוּסִים. בַּזּוֹנָה וּבַיַּיִן וּבְשׁוֹד חֲמָסִים. אֵיךְ בַּדִּין יִהְיוּ נֶעֱמָסִים: בְּהִתְיַצְּבוֹ לָרִיב
God of faith, when Thou dost order justice and dost penetrate the depth of justice, who can then be justified before Thee in justice, O Holy One.
If He does not act for His own sake and remove wrath and anger, it is futile for us to search and find actions, O Holy One.

Those who resolutely subdue their desire, they too were found guilty when examined in justice as though no delight had been found in them. The first man formed from the dust of the earth, who was comparable to the heavenly angels, failed to understand and he became like a mere shadow. To till and care for the garden had God set him apart; when he transgressed His commandment, then he drove him away; but this day became his intercessor. When He awoke that radiant one (Abraham) from the dark, the world had been empty and dark, after twenty generations despised and dejected; though he showed the straight and even path to those who had strayed, yet since he himself said ‘how shall I know’, it was decreed against him ‘you shall surely know’ (the sufferings of your descendants). As for those who pass through the valley of tears to be tested, when the Lord judges the case according to their deeds, who will then be justified before the Judge? The pure one who offered his life as a sacrifice (Isaac), did not find comfort in his old age, for his eyes became dim through the idolatrous smoke of the fool (Esau). He who trained his children in the tents of the Torah (Jacob), since he said ‘My way is hidden’, his offspring (Joseph) was long concealed from him. The wicked man who plots in secret, drives away justice and rejects it, can he hide himself on the day of wrath? When the Lord tested the twelve brothers, He did not pronounce them just, for they had sold the righteous one for silver. The sons of the nameless (Chaldeans), who sold Israel for lechery, wine and violent plunder, how heavy will be their burden when brought to Justice. When the Lord arises to strive, when He

בְּעָמְדוֹ לָדִין. עַל זֹאת אוֹתָם יָדִין. לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן שַׁדּוּן בְּדִין: יֶרֶד אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִיד אֲמָרִים. וְהִדְרִיר בְּכוֹר שׁוֹר מֵחֲמוֹרִים. וְנֶעֱנַשׁ בְּשִׁמְעוּ נָא הַמּוֹרִים: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר נוֹקַשׁ בְּעֶשֶׂר. נֶחֶרְתוּ בוֹ מִיתוֹת עֶשֶׂר. וּכְגָע גְּבוּל כֻּבַּל בְּאֵסֶר: רָאשֶׁיהָ אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁחַד יִשְׁפּוֹטוּ. אֵיךְ בְּכֵן צֶדֶק יִשָּׁפֵטוּ. כִּי אִם כְּמוֹ שָׁפָטוּ: רוֹבִים עֲלֵי אֵשׁ זָרָה. פָּגְעָה בָם בְּאַף גְּזֵרָה. לְלַמֵּד בָּם פּוֹשְׁעֵי פְזוּרָה: בַּעַר חָמַד מִן הַחֵרֶם. וְנִלְכַּד הוּא וְכָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בַּחֵרֶם. מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד קָמָה וָכֶרֶם: בּוֹגֵד וְשׁוֹדֵד מַה מּוֹעִיל. הוֹן בְּעֶבְרָה לֹא יוֹעִיל. כִּי אִם לְחַלּוֹת פְּנֵי מְלַמֵּד לְהוֹעִיל: יָד שָׁלַח אֱחוֹז בָּאָרוֹן. נַעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ מִשְׁפָּט וְחָרוֹן. מַה יַּעֲשׂוּ עוֹבְרֵי כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן: יוֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן כְּפָץ בְּחָנֵנִי. נִבְחַן וְנָם חִנָּם חָנֵּנִי. וְאַל תָּבֹא בְּמִשְׁפָּט לְדַיְּנֵנִי: קוֹרְאֵי בְגָרוֹן וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר. אִם פִּשְׁעָם בְּדִין יִסָּפֵר. בְּמַתְּנַת חִנָּם הַיּוֹם יְכֻפָּר: קָצִין כְּגָאָה לְקַטֵּר לַשֵּׁם. נֶגַע בְּמִצְחוֹ זָרַח לְהֵרָשֵׁם. וְנִשְׁפַּט בְּלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם: לְעֵת תָּמוּט רֶגֶל זֵדִים. אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ לְהֵיכָל מְזִידִים. יִשָּׁפְטוּ בְּמַכְנִיעַ זֵדִים: לְעֵת יְבֻקְרוּ פֹּעֲלֵי שֶׁקֶר. לְהִשָּׁפֵט בְּוִכּוּחַ אַף וְחֵקֶר. יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי שָׁקֶר: יָשָׁר מִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. אֵיךְ אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים וְהָאֱמֶת. חִשַּׁב פָּעֳלוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת: יְדִיד אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וְאַחֲרָיו. לֹא קָם כָּמֹהוּ בִּבְחִירָיו. וְאַחֲרֵי כָל זֹאת דִּקְדֵּק אַחֲרָיו: יָבִינוּ כָּל יְצוּרֵי אָרֶץ. אִם כֵּן בִּמְצוּקֵי אָרֶץ. מַה יַּעֲשׂוּ רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ: רָאֹה יִרְאוּ יַעֲרֵי שִׂיחִים.

stands upright for justice, for this He will condemn them, that they may know judgment in justice. Yered (Moses), who brought the words of God from Sinai, who led the firstborn (Israel) out from among the Egyptians, he too was punished when he said: ‘Listen, you rebels’. For Israel’s trial of the Lord ten times he shared the penalty, his death was announced to him ten times; and when he reached the border of the Holy Land he was restrained. Judges, when they judge through bribery, how can they expect to be judged with charity? As they have judged others, so shall it be done to them. The youths (Nadab and Abibu) who offered up strange fire, suffered the decree of wrath as a warning to evil doers among the dispersed people (Israel). The fool desired what was banned, he too was caught within the ban with all that was his, the heaps of corn, the standing corn and vineyard. What avail his deeds to the faithless and the robber, substance avails not on the day of wrath, only entreaty before Him whose teaching avails. He (Usha) stretched out his hand to grasp the Holy Ark, and judgment and wrath overtook him; what shall they do who pass before Him like lambs? When the skilled player on the harp (David) said, ‘Test me’, he was tested; but then he said, ‘Since I am without merit, be lenient with me, do not come in judgment to judge me’. They who call out aloud and blow the Shofar, when their misdeeds are counted in judgment, as an undeserved gift let them be atoned this day. The prince (Uzziah), when he dared to bring incense to the Lord, was marked on the forehead with distinct leprosy and so was he judged for unwitting transgression. When there falters the foot of the proud, who arrogantly entered the Sanctuary, they too will come to be judged by Him who humbles the proud. When those who act falsely come to be tested, with angry argument and question to be judged, then the mouth of those who speak falsehood, will be silenced. The upright (Hezekiah) walked before Him in truth, yet after his good deeds and his truth, the God of truth condemned one of his deeds. The favourite (Josiah) whom none among the chosen of the Lord resembled before or after, was yet severely judged by the Lord. So let all creatures on earth understand, since such was the fate of pillars of the earth, what are the sinners on earth to do. Let them look at

אִם אֵשׁ אָחֲזָה בַּלַּחִים. אָז יָנוּעוּ יְבֵשִׁים כְּסוּחִים: רְאֵה כִּי אֵין אִישׁ. לְהַפְגִּיעַ בְּעַד בְּנֵי אִישׁ. וְאַתָּה אֵל וְלֹא אִישׁ: רָשׁוּם בִּכְתַב אֱמֶת אֲשַׁנְּנָה. מַעֲשֵׂה כָּל יְמוֹת הַשָּׁנָה. לְרַצּוֹתְךָ בְּשׁוֹפָר (אַם שַׁבָּת בְּזִכְרוֹן שׁוֹפָר) בְּזֶה רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה:
ח׳
וּבְכֵן וַיְהִי בִּישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ: (נ״א וּבְכֵן נַמְלִיכְךָ מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן:)
חזן.
פותחים הארון.
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. אֵל דָּר בַּמָּרוֹם. אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם. אֹמֶץ יָדוֹ תָּרוּם. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. גִּבּוֹר לְהָקִים. גּוֹזֵר וּמֵקִים. גּוֹלֶה עֲמוּקִים. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. הַמְדַבֵּר בִּצְדָקָה. הַלּוֹבֵשׁ צְדָקָה. הַמַּאֲזִין צְעָקָה. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. זוֹכֵר צוּרִים. זַכּוֹת יְצוּרִים. זוֹעֵם צָרִים. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. טוֹב שׁוֹכֵן עַד. טוּבוֹ לָעַד. טִפַּח שְׁמֵי עַד. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. כַּשַּׂלְמָה עוֹטֶה אוֹר. כָּל מְאוֹרֵי אוֹר. כַּבִּיר וְנָאוֹר. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָמִים. מְפַעֲנֵחַ נֶעֱלָמִים. מֵשִׂיחַ אִלְּמִים. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:

the dense forests; when the fire reaches the fresh trunks, then let the dry and severed ones tremble. Behold there is no man to entreat on behalf of the children of man, but Thou art God and not a man. Let me repeat what is inscribed in the script of truth, the work of all the days of the year, in order to appease Thee with the Shofar sound (the memory of the Shofar) on this day of the New Year.
And thus was He King in Yeshurun (Therefore let us crown Thee, Supreme King.)
Supreme King. God dwells on high, He is mighty on high, the might of His hand is high, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Strong to fulfil, decreeing and fulfilling, revealing the deep, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Speaking in righteousness, clothed in righteousness, listening to complaints, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Remembering the rocks (forefathers) to justify their descendants, angry with their enemies, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Benevolent, everlasting, His kindness is everlasting, He spreads out the heavens everlasting, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Draped in light as in a gown, He gives light ot all lights, mighty and luminous, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. King of eternity, revealing secrets, making the dumb speak, He will reign forever.
חזן.
